title: Anjo the Mischievous Gal
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Seto, a serious second-year student in Kasugai, is teased daily by his flashy gyaru classmate Anna Anjo, sometimes in suggestive ways. After he defends her from a classmate's insults, the teasing grows into a romance, and their friends Toyoda, Chita, Inuyama and Tokio pair off too.
life_message: It holds up loyalty and kindness beneath appearances, and the courage to let affection show.
